_comment: Cards that exist only for the finality-counter test (tests/unit/counters/test_finality_counter.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_fabricator_like` is Shuri's Fabricator's second line with nothing else on the body; `t_artifact_this_dies` is an artifact creature that says when it dies.

cards.name: Test Fabricator
cards.oracle_text: {6}, {T}: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery. (If a permanent with a finality counter on it would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.)

abilities.text: {6}, {T}: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery. (If a permanent with a finality counter on it would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.)
